title: International Baccalaureate Diploma in Information Technology (Level 6)
description: The purpose of this program is to equip students with the technical and analytical skills needed to excel in the fast-evolving field of information technology and address the challenges of a digital world.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and OTHM UK
longDescription: The purpose of this Endorsed International Higher Diploma in Information Technology (Level 6) is to develop students professionally and individually, enabling them to meet the demands of the rapidly changing tech sector. This course enhances your ability to analyze complex IT issues, design innovative solutions, and apply advanced technological concepts to real-world problems, equipping you with the skills to excel in higher education or IT careers and thrive in the ever-evolving digital landscape. This Endorsed International Higher Diploma in Information Technology (Level 6) serves as a foundation for your continued education in technology and opens doors to a wide range of career opportunities in the ever-growing IT sector. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: Each module consists of 40 guided learning hours of material with an additional 30-50 hours worth of optional materials which comprise of recommended exercises, recommended readings and internet resources. Within the modules are self-testing exercises. You must take care in answering these. Although they are not marked nor do they count towards your final assessment, the marking is tested against your scoring on the final assessment to check for consistency of score. Successful completion of the full Level 6 endorsed Diploma in Information Technology will provide students with the right credentials to pursue careers in software development, network administration, IT consultancy, data analysis, and other dynamic roles within the tech industry.

entry: For entry into Level 6 International Higher Diploma in Information Technology, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership, or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: After completing this Level 6 endorsed qualification, students can progress to a variety of university courses that align with their academic and career goals or potential university progression pathways.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
